title: AI-assisted preparation prompts
body: Tool-agnostic prompts. AI drafts; a named human reviews facts, sharing, and capability claims before anything is used or sent.

lines.label: Authorized inputs
lines.text: Reviewed maps, value model, metric cards and decision process.

lines.label: Prompt
lines.text: Draft a concise executive narrative around the decision required. Include business priority, workflow change, evidence-labeled value, success criteria, unresolved dependencies and lightest sufficient validation. State any pilot approval/commercial boundary without assuming approval. Do not send or publish.

lines.label: Required output
lines.text: Readout outline; decision log; recommendation; proposed MAP.

lines.label: Human review
lines.text: AE/SE and authorized value owner approve; customer confirms decisions.
